description: Vaults that sgraph.ai exposes with a PUBLIC read key. The read keys below are published by design — they grant read-only access to already-public content. Write keys are never listed here. Each vault may also carry an in-vault `_vault-meta.json` (owner-maintained) that this registry is enriched with at view time.

vaults.label: Library Content
vaults.purpose: Library articles, use-case pages, and the library nav tree (_nav.json). Served at /en-gb/library/ and as .md/.llm.json via edge-render.

vaults.label: Project Status
vaults.purpose: Live project status — workstreams, issues, and the agent roster. Rendered as structured JSON views in the Dev sub-site.

vaults.label: Dev Docs
vaults.purpose: Developer documentation sub-site — the agent operating model, Email-FS protocol, vault architecture, and onboarding guides.

vaults.label: Invest
vaults.purpose: Investor-facing content for the (unlisted) /en-gb/invest sub-site. Read key is public; the page is simply not linked from the main nav.
